propositions: Normal compaction, fsck rebuild, and crash recovery each independently re-derive candidate listing, snapshot file detection, snapshot envelope structure, retired-source restoration, and commit semantics

Three separate snapshot envelope builders (_build_snapshot_event in compact_txn and inline copy in compact_rebuild) and three retire-restore implementations must be consolidated into a single source of truth
A consolidation guard must prevent new snapshot-envelope keys (source_event_uuids, compacted_at) or retired-rename logic (os.rename with retired argument) from appearing outside compact_plan.py
Rebuild's per-file rename-failure tolerance and .snapshot-rebuild.bak idempotent-restart model must be preserved unchanged; only fold and recovery receive abort-and-rollback semantics
A stray non-.json file in a ticket directory was incorrectly included in source_event_uuids and retired; list_candidates must require .json or .json.retired suffix to converge behavior
